title: Oversize Openings and the United-Inch Surcharge
content:
# Oversize Openings and the United-Inch Surcharge

Estimating note for Window Replacement Contracts.

**Rule.** Each opening is sized in united inches, the measured width plus the measured height with each rounded up to the next whole inch, at the final measure. An opening up to the series standard bracket is priced in the base price. An opening above the standard bracket and up to the series maximum carries the series oversize surcharge per opening, written as one change order line of kind oversize surcharge dated the final measure date for all such openings together; this line is not a customer change order and never counts toward the free or maximum change-order counts. An opening above the series maximum cannot be built in the series: before order release the customer either moves the contract to a series whose maximum covers it or removes that opening for credit.

The surcharge line amount is the series oversize surcharge per opening times the number of oversize openings, rounded to the cent. The bracket, maximum and surcharge are each series' own figures.

## Judgement by opening size

| United inches of the opening | Result |
|---|---|
| Up to and including the series standard bracket | Priced in the base price; no surcharge |
| Above the standard bracket, up to and including the series maximum | Series oversize surcharge per opening |
| Above the series maximum | Cannot be built in the series; before order release, the contract moves to a series whose maximum covers it, or the opening is removed for credit |

## Hypothetical worked line

A completed final measure on a hypothetical contract finds 2 openings above the standard bracket and within the series maximum, in a series with a hypothetical surcharge of $100 per opening. One oversize surcharge line of $200.00 (2 times $100) is written, dated the final measure date, covering both openings together. It does not count as a customer change order.
